adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) && (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0))`, which (1) awaits the two checks sequentially (extra latency vs `Promise.all`) and (2) still runs both checks even when `booking.eventType?.teamId` is null/undefined (falls back to `0`), potentially causing avoidable DB round trips for non-team bookings. This is a concrete performance/efficiency issue shown by the diff, not a functional defect.
